breaking_news.headline: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
breaking_news.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

breaking_news.headline: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

breaking_news.headline: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

breaking_news.headline: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
breaking_news.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

breaking_news.headline: Here's the latest sticker shock: Borrowing for a mortgage -- or a car
breaking_news.summary: It's not just mortgages being at their highest level in almost three years — but the cost of loans for cars and higher education are among the borrowing costs affected, too.

breaking_news.headline: Who will win the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics?
breaking_news.summary: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point. We explore potential winners and the big ideas that could earn them economics' biggest prize.

breaking_news.headline: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
breaking_news.summary: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

breaking_news.headline: As crypto and prediction markets expand, their regulator shrinks
breaking_news.summary: Even as the agency is tasked with drawing up new rules for crypto and prediction markets, its staffing and enforcement actions have dropped precipitously during the second Trump administration.

breaking_news.headline: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
breaking_news.summary: The Mapocho river has burst its banks after an unusually large amount of rain fell in recent days.

breaking_news.headline: Teacher who sexually abused pupil back in Indonesia jail after BBC investigation
breaking_news.summary: Mochamad Subchi Azal Tsani had been secretly released on parole in 2025, after serving less than half his sentence.

breaking_news.headline: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering, rights group says
breaking_news.summary: More than 500 migrants have been expelled from the US to African countries, HRW says, citing US data.

breaking_news.headline: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

breaking_news.headline: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
breaking_news.summary: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

breaking_news.headline: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
breaking_news.summary: The new accusations relate to the alleged torture of US citizens held in Venezuela while Maduro was in power.

breaking_news.headline: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: A lawyer says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections.

breaking_news.headline: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting two crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

breaking_news.headline: The wildlife winners set to appear on your banknotes revealed
breaking_news.summary: The decision comes after nearly half a million people voted on a shortlist of 18 creatures.

breaking_news.headline: 'Stop throwing shade' - the woman trying to stop firms leaving the UK
breaking_news.summary: British people need more incentives to invest in big firms listed in the UK, Dame Julia Hoggett, boss of the London Stock Exchange, says.

breaking_news.headline: How oil-rich Alberta's economy might fare if it broke away from Canada
breaking_news.summary: Albertans vote this month on staying in Canada or moving ahead to a binding independence referendum.

breaking_news.headline: Plans to shut Marston's Brewery in Burton revealed
breaking_news.summary: Burton-upon-Trent's links with beer and brewing date back centuries.
